backtest.seoDesc:
This platform is a portfolio backtesting tool supporting ETFs, stocks, funds, synthetic assets and custom series. Compare multiple portfolios over the same historical period, test rebalancing rules, and simulate contributions or withdrawals.

Supports benchmark comparison, total return settings, inflation adjustment, rolling window statistics, and retirement withdrawal simulations.

View drawdowns, rolling returns, correlations, Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, Calmar ratio, and detailed retirement withdrawal success rates.
backtest.seoModelableDesc: Portfolio weights, date ranges, rebalancing schedules, cashflows, inflation, drag and withdrawal assumptions.
backtest.seoViewableDesc: CAGR, MWRR, volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar ratios, rolling metrics, seasonality, correlations and retirement withdrawal statistics.

params.title: Parameter Settings
params.basicParamsInfo: Set backtest date range, starting value, currency, inflation adjustment, rolling window and benchmark ticker.
params.endDateAfterToday: End date cannot be later than today
params.startDateAfterEnd: Start date cannot be later than end date
params.endDateBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date
params.advancedSettingsInfo: Set annual drag, total return mode and rebalancing deviation bands for each portfolio. Bands support symmetric (absolute/relative) and asymmetric (upper/lower) modes.
params.cashflowLegsInfo: Periodic cashflows: set amount, type (contribution/withdrawal), frequency, offset and end date. Multiple legs can be added.
params.oneTimeCashflowInfo: One-time contribution or withdrawal on a specified date. Multiple entries can be added.
